shots.title: The Afternoon
shots.cue: On the afternoon of November 24th, 1971, a quiet man in a dark suit

shots.title: One Way, Portland
shots.cue: bought a one-way ticket at Portland International Airport. He gave his name as Dan Cooper.

shots.title: The Note
shots.cue: Shortly after takeoff, he handed a flight attendant a note. It said he had a bomb.

shots.title: The Demand
shots.cue: He asked for two hundred thousand dollars in twenty-dollar bills, and four parachutes.

shots.title: Seattle
shots.cue: In Seattle, the money arrived. The passengers walked free.

shots.title: The Low Turn
shots.cue: The Boeing 727 took off again, flying low toward Mexico City.

shots.title: Dark Forests
shots.cue: Somewhere over the dark forests of southwest Washington,

shots.title: The Airstair
shots.cue: the rear staircase came down, and the man stepped out into freezing rain.

shots.title: Nothing
shots.cue: No body was ever found. No parachute. No suspect.

shots.title: The File
shots.cue: The FBI opened one of the longest investigations in its history. Eight years later,

shots.title: The Riverbank
shots.cue: a boy digging on the bank of the Columbia River uncovered a bundle

shots.title: The Serial Numbers
shots.cue: of rotting twenty-dollar bills. The serial numbers matched. And that is where the trail ends.
